name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, arms extended overhead, legs straight.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor — no gap.
Lift shoulders and legs slightly off the ground into a shallow banana shape.
Keep ribs down and hold 15-30 seconds; bend the knees if the back starts to arch.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight core exercise for the abs. Hollow Hold builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
